newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, July 22 - Santa Fe - No vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Max. draft 29 ft. 08 in. at access channel. Diamante - No vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Max. draft 29 ft. 08 in. at passage KM 520. San Lorenzo - Seven vessels berthed of which 1 loading sbmp, 4 loading sbm, 1 loading wheat, 1 loading sunoil. 13 Vessels in roads, 35 due at 6 terminals during the week. The forecast indicates that the draft is rising approx. 0.05 metres during next week. Pasa berth draft 23 ft. 11 in. fw. Rosario - Seven vessels berthed of which 2 loading maize, 1 loading wheat, 1 discharging sbo, 1 loading sbo, 1 loading sbmp, 1 loading sbm. 6 Vessels in roads, 12 due during the week. The forecast indicates that the draft is rising approx. 0.05 metres during next week.

Villa Constitucion - One vessel discharging iron ore, no vessels in roads, 2 due. Elevator berths - Max. draft 22 ft. 0 in. fw. San Nicolas - Two vessels berthed of which 1 discharging iron ore, 1 discharging fertiliser. 2 Vessels in roads, 10 due during the week. The forecast indicates that the draft is rising approx. 0.05 metres during next week. San Pedro - Four vessels due. San Lorenzo, Rosario, San Nicolas, San Pedro - Max. recommended draft 32 ft. 06 in./33 ft. 00 in. fw high tide. Buenos Aires - 17 Vessels in port, 25 due during the week. Max. recommended draft 31 ft. 06 in. fw high tide naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Dock Sud - Max. recommended draft 28/29 ft. fw. high tide naabsa (guided by entrance channel).

Necochea - Six vessels berthed of which 1 loading maize, 2 discharging dap, 1 loading sfmp, 1 loading lpg. 5 Vessels in roads, 10 due during the week. Max. recommended draft 40 ft. bw. Bahia Blanca - Eight vessels berthed of which 2 awaiting orders, 1 loading maize, 1 loading sfp, 1 discharging dap, 1 loading sfo, 2 loading fuel oil. 3 Vessels in roads, 7 due during the week. Draft depends on each berth.

BRAZIL, July 22 - Vitoria - Vessels berthed, 1 Paper coils loader, 1 bulk wheat loader, 1 granite loader, 1 steel tubes loader, 1 container/general cargo discharger/loader, 1 vehicles discharger, 1 pig iron loader, 1 general cargo discharger. Tubarao - 3 Iron ore loaders, 1 fuel discharger. Praia Mole - 3 Steel products loaders, 2 coal dischargers. 15 Vessels waiting in roads. Santos - Stevedores working normally. Vessels berthed, 5 full container loaders/dischargers, 4 container loaders, 1 container discharger, 1 bulk cement, 1 bulk chemical products discharger, 2 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 6 sugar loaders, 1 citrus juice loader, 1 bulk sulphur loader, 1 general cargo discharger, 1 container/bulk juice loader/discharger, 1 soya loader, 1 salt discharger, 2 bulk wheat dischargers, 1 bulk diesel oil loader. 28 Vessels waiti in roads, 89 due during next 7 days.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 1 Iron ore discharger, 1 steel products loader, 1 bulk coal discharger. Ultrafertil - 1 Bulk fertiliser discharger. Rio de Janeiro - Vessels berthed, 2 general cargo/steel products dischargers, 1 general cargo/container discharger, 1 caustic soda discharger, 3 wheat dischargers, 1 general cargo/steel products loader, 1 general cargo loader, 1 sugar loader. Tecon - 1 Vessel, 34 due during next 7 days. Sao Sebtiao - Three vessels berthed at tebar, 2 waiting in roads, 5 due during next 7 days. Paranagua - Vessels berthed, 3 fertiliser dischargers, 1 general cargo discharger, 3 sugar loaders, 4 pellets loaders, 1 soya loader, 1 general cargo loader, 1 reefer loader. 34 Vessels waiting in roads of which for loading, 8 sugar, 11 pellets, 1 general cargo, 3 soya. For discharging, 8 fertiliser, 3 general cargo. 32 Vessels due during next 7 days. Rio Grande - Vessels berthed, 3 full container loaders, 2 soya loaders, 1 soya beans loader, 1 wheat loader, 1 fertiliser discharger. 2 Vesse

CHILE, July 21 - Arica - One vessel in terminal, 5 berths vacant. 15 Vessels due during the week, port working normally. Iquique - Three vessels berthed, 16 due during the week. Antofagasta - Four vessels berthed, 1 berth available. 11 Vessels due during the week for loading and discharging of concentrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo. Valparaiso - Five vessels berthed, working normally, 4 berths vacant, 1 berth out of service due to enlargement of pier until April 1998. 7 Vessels due during the week. San Antonio - Seven vessels operating, 2 berths vacant. 6 Vessels due during the week, working normally. Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - One vessel berthed, 3 due during the week, none waiting in roads. San Vicente - Three vessels berthed, working normally. 4 Vessels due during the week. Navy pier (Molo 500) - No vessels. Steel pier - 1 Vessel berthed, none due. Coronel pier - 1 Vessel berthed. Oil terminal - 1 Vessel due during the week. Lirquen - Three vessels berthed, 3 berths vacant. 4

PERU, July 21 - Callao - Six vessels in bay, 4 in pier (general cargo/containers). No berthing delays. Paita - Two fishmeal vessels in pier. No berthing delays. Bayovar, Pisco - No vessels. Talara - Three oil vessels in bay. No berthing delays. Chimbote - Three vessels in bay, 4 in pier (general cargo). No berthing delays. Ilo - Two copper/fishmeal vessels in pier. No berthing delays.

VENEZUELA, July 22 - Orinoco river - Draft 35 ft. 0 in. Puerto Ordaz - Two vessels operating of which 1 loading briquettes, 1 discharging manganese, 3 vessels due. Boca Grande - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 1 due. Palua - Two vessels loading iron ore, 1 vessel due. Mile 178 - Five vessels waiting at anchorage to load/discharge. Matanzas - Four vessels operating of which 3 loading steel products, 1 discharging limestone, 4 vessels due. San Felix - One vessel loading aluminium. Punta Cuchillo - One vessel loading refined products, 1 vessel due. Venalum - Two vessels operating of which 1 loading aluminium, 1 discharging pitch. Alcasa - Two vessels discharging coke. Interalumina - One vessel loading alumina. Puerto Bello - 11 Vessels operating of which 10 loading generals, 1 discharging sugar. 17 Vessels due, 2 under repair. Guanta - Seven vessels due.
